import os
# parse newc cpio
src='/tmp/initramfs.cpio'; out='/tmp/initrd'
data=open(src,'rb').read(); i=0; n=0
while True:
    if data[i:i+6] not in (b'070701',b'070702'): print('bad magic at',i,data[i:i+10]); break
    def h(off,l):
        return int(data[i+off:i+off+l],16)
    ino=h(6,8); mode=h(14,8); filesize=h(54,8); namesize=h(94,8); name=data[i+110:i+110+namesize-1].decode(errors='replace')
    i += 110+namesize
    i = (i+3)&~3
    content=data[i:i+filesize]
    i += filesize
    i = (i+3)&~3
    if name=='TRAILER!!!': break
    p=os.path.join(out,name.lstrip('/'))
    if name.endswith('/'):
        os.makedirs(p,exist_ok=True)
    elif mode & 0o170000 == 0o120000:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
        try: os.symlink(content.decode(),p)
        except FileExistsError: pass
    else:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
        with open(p,'wb') as f: f.write(content)
        try: os.chmod(p, mode & 0o7777)
        except: pass
    n+=1
print('extracted',n)
